no_adcom_quote.quote: An advisory committee meeting was not considered to be necessary during this review cycle.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the original NDA 21-928 (CHANTIX/varenicline) review cycle. The Medical Review's Section 8.5 (Advisory Committee Meeting) states plainly that such a meeting was not considered necessary, and the administrative correspondence checklist leaves the Advisory Committee Meeting and Date of Meeting fields blank. Because no committee met, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
